scope: read-only login-node inspection; no job submission

probes.name: account_limits
probes.script: sacctmgr -nP show user where name="$(id -un)" format=User,DefaultAccount; sacctmgr -nP show qos where name=normal,restricted format=Name,Flags,GrpTRES,GrpTRESMins,MaxTRESPerUser,MaxJobsPerUser,MaxSubmitJobsPerUser,MaxWall; sacctmgr -nP show assoc where account=imet-2026-2 user='' format=Cluster,Account,User,ParentName,QOS,GrpTRES,GrpTRESMins,GrpTRESRunMins,MaxTRES,MaxWall

probes.name: software_paths
probes.script: find -L /opt -maxdepth 3 \( -iname '*vasp*' -o -iname '*lammps*' -o -iname '*miniconda*' -o -iname '*pytorch*' \) -print 2>/dev/null; ls -1 "$HOME" | head -80; if [ -d "$HOME/Keller/SOFT" ]; then ls -1 "$HOME/Keller/SOFT"; fi; for path in "$HOME/VASP" "$HOME/vasp" "$HOME/SOFT" "$HOME/Keller/SOFT"; do if [ -d "$path" ]; then find "$path" -maxdepth 5 -type f \( -name 'vasp_std' -o -name 'vasp_gam' -o -name 'vasp_ncl' -o -name 'vasp' \) -print; fi; done

probes.name: environment_metadata
